commands.name: project.read
commands.description: Read the project: size, aspect, media, tracks and clips with their timeline times (seconds).

commands.name: project.aspect
commands.description: Set the canvas aspect: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.

commands.name: project.mode
commands.description: Switch between quick mode (CapCut-style) and pro mode (multitrack). Both edit the same project.

commands.name: clip.add
commands.description: Put an imported media item on the timeline. With no start it goes at the end of the track (quick mode).

commands.name: clip.insert
commands.description: Insert a source range of a media file at a timeline time: a clip under that time splits and later clips move along (on the main track). in and out are source seconds.

trackId.description: Track (default: main or the first audio track)

commands.name: clip.split
commands.description: Split a clip at a timeline time (seconds).

commands.name: clip.trim
commands.description: Move a clip edge. edge "start" or "end"; to is the new timeline time in seconds.

commands.name: clip.remove
commands.description: Delete a clip. On the main track later clips close the gap.

ripple.description: Close the gap (default: the track decides)

commands.name: clip.move
commands.description: Move a clip to a new start time and optionally another track of the same kind.

commands.name: clip.set
commands.description: Change clip properties: volume (0–2), fadeIn, fadeOut, speed (0.25–4), opacity, scale, x, y, rotation, fit (fit|fill|blur), look (none|vivid|warm|cool|mono|fade|noir|sunset), blend (normal|multiply|screen|overlay|darken|lighten|difference|color-dodge|soft-light), filters {brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature} each -1..1, reverse (true plays the clip backwards), transitionIn {type: crossfade|fade|wipe|slide|zoom|push|iris|whip, duration, dir: right|left for wipe and slide} or null, text, style, muted; on a camera clip, camera {preset, intensity, shake, freq, seed} (see camera.add).

commands.name: text.add
commands.description: Add a text overlay on the text track. x and y place its centre (fractions of the frame, default 0.5, 0.82). style may set: font, size (fraction of the height, default 0.06), weight, color, stroke, strokeWidth, box, boxColor, align (center|left|right), letterSpacing (fraction of the size, -0.1..0.5), lineHeight (0.8..2.5, default 1.18), shadow (a colour, or false), shadowBlur and shadowOffset (fractions of the size), gradient [top colour, bottom colour], maxLines (shrink the text until it wraps to at most this many lines; 0 for no limit), highlight (karaoke colour). Text always shrinks when one word is wider than the title-safe width.

commands.name: marker.add
commands.description: Add a marker at a timeline time.

commands.name: playhead.seek
commands.description: Move the playhead to a timeline time.

commands.name: edit.undo
commands.description: Undo the last edit.

commands.name: edit.redo
commands.description: Redo the last undone edit (also Mod+Shift+Z).

commands.name: assist.silences
commands.description: Cut quiet stretches out of a clip (on this device). threshold in dBFS (default -40), minSilence seconds (default 0.6).

commands.name: assist.scenes
commands.description: Split a video clip where the picture changes sharply (on this device).

commands.name: assist.captions
commands.description: Write captions from the speech in a clip onto the Captions track, on this device (Whisper tiny). Works only after the person has downloaded the speech model.

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, hi, fr

commands.name: captions.srt
commands.description: Read the Captions track as SubRip (.srt) text.

commands.name: transcript.make
commands.description: Transcribe a clip's media into words on this device (Whisper tiny), so it can be edited by its words. Works only after the person has downloaded the speech model.

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, hi, fr

commands.name: transcript.read
commands.description: Read a clip's transcript as words [index, text, timeline seconds or null when the word is cut out]. Word times are estimates.

commands.name: transcript.cut
commands.description: Cut the words from index `from` to index `to` (inclusive, from transcript.read) out of the video; later clips close up.

clipId.description: A clip of the transcribed media

commands.name: assist.fillers
commands.description: Cut every filler word (um, uh, er, hmm) from a transcribed clip.

clipId.description: A clip of the transcribed media

commands.name: assist.duck
commands.description: Lower the music under the speech on the video tracks, as volume keyframes. clipIds: music clips to duck (default: every clip on an audio track). depth: the volume under speech as a fraction (default 0.25, about -12 dB).

commands.name: track.mix
commands.description: Set a track's gain (0-2, 1 is unchanged) and pan (-1 left to 1 right).

commands.name: captions.vtt
commands.description: Read the Captions track as WebVTT text.

commands.name: clip.freeze
commands.description: Freeze a video clip on the frame at a timeline time for a number of seconds; the clip splits there and later clips move along.

at.description: Timeline time of the frame, seconds

length.description: How long to hold it, seconds (default 2)

commands.name: assist.slideshow
commands.description: Turn the photos on the main track into a slideshow: each lasts `length` seconds, joined by a transition, with a slow zoom.

transition.description: crossfade, fade, wipe or slide (default crossfade)

zoom.description: End scale of the slow zoom, 1 for none (default 1.08)

commands.name: clip.detach_audio
commands.description: Give a video clip's sound its own clip on an audio track and mute the video clip, so the two can be edited apart.

commands.name: clip.slide
commands.description: Slide a clip between its neighbours by `by` seconds (positive is later); the neighbours give and take, the clip's content and the track length stay the same.

commands.name: clip.grade
commands.description: Colour-grade a video clip: lift, gamma and gain as [r, g, b] (lift -0.3..0.3, default 0; gamma and gain 0.5..2, default 1) and curve [shadows, midtones, highlights] output levels 0..1 (default [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]). Pass only what changes.

commands.name: clip.key
commands.description: Chroma key a clip (green screen): on, color (#rrggbb, default #00ff00), similarity 0..0.6, smoothness 0..0.4, spill 0..1.

similarity.description: How close a colour must be to vanish

spill.description: How much key colour to remove from edges

commands.name: captions.style
commands.description: Restyle every caption: clean, boxed, bold, pop.

commands.name: assist.autocut
commands.description: Find the beat of the music on the audio track and cut the main-track clips so each ends on a beat. every: cut every 1, 2 or 4 beats (default 2).

commands.name: clip.nest
commands.description: Put clips into a nest: one clip that plays them together, and a new item in the media bin. clipIds: the clips to nest.

commands.name: clip.unnest
commands.description: Put a full-length nest clip's clips back on the timeline.

commands.name: assist.clean
commands.description: Remove background noise from a clip's voice with RNNoise on this device; the clip's sound switches to a cleaned copy (a video clip's sound is detached first). Works only after the person has downloaded the noise model.

commands.name: assist.reframe
commands.description: Make the canvas 9:16 (or the aspect given) and pan a wide video clip to follow its subject, as x keyframes.

commands.name: assist.highlights
commands.description: Pick up to three highlights of about `seconds` from a transcribed clip with the NakliOS model, mark each, and set the I/O range to the best for a range export.

commands.name: assist.remove_background
commands.description: Cut the person out of a video or photo clip (MODNet on this device); put a background under it on a lower track. Works only after the person has downloaded the model.

commands.name: script.run
commands.description: Run a list of nVideo commands as one edit: steps [{command, input}]. A string "$N.key" in an input is the value `key` from step N's result (1-based), for example "$1.clipId". The whole script is one undo step; if any step fails, nothing changes and the error names the step.

commands.name: project.set
commands.description: Set project fields: name, fps (24, 25, 30, 50, 60), background (#rrggbb), mode (quick or pro), motionBlur {samples 1-16, shutter 0-1} or null. Motion blur applies to exports only: each exported frame averages `samples` renders spread over `shutter` of the frame interval (0.5 is a 180 degree shutter), so keyed moves, cameras and text and graphic animation streak; motion inside the footage is not blurred again. samples 1 or null turns it off; 8 samples at shutter 0.5 is a good start and makes the export about 8 times slower.

motionBlur.description: Export motion blur {samples: 1-16, shutter: 0-1 (default 0.5)}, or null for off

commands.name: track.add
commands.description: Add a track of a kind (video, audio or text), optionally named. Returns its id.

commands.name: clip.keyframe
commands.description: Key a clip property at a timeline time. prop: x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, volume. ease (how the value moves to the next key): linear, in, out, inOut, expoIn, expoOut, hold.

commands.name: audio.beats
commands.description: Find the beat of a music clip: tempo (BPM) and beat times on the timeline, for placing cuts or titles on beats.

commands.name: audio.loudness
commands.description: Measure the loudness of the mix as it would be exported (EBU R128): integrated LUFS, loudness range, true and sample peak in dBTP, maximum momentary and short-term loudness. target: also report what normalising to this many LUFS (true peak under -1 dBTP) gives, the same as the export does; reached is false, with a note, when the peak ceiling stops it short. range: only the marked range.

target.description: Normalise to this many LUFS first (for example -14)

commands.name: edit.history
commands.description: The undo history, oldest first: [{id, label, by}] where by is person or api. It is saved with the project, so it survives closing the tab.

commands.name: frame.snapshot
commands.description: Render the frame at a timeline time as a small JPEG data URL (default 480 px wide), to look at the result.

commands.name: view.snapshot
commands.description: What the person sees: the frame at the playhead (or at `at`) as a JPEG data URL, at most 1024 px wide (default 960), plus a text summary of the tracks, clips, duration, the clips under that time and the selection. The same picture as frame.snapshot.

commands.name: doc.describe
commands.description: A compact description of the whole project for planning: size, aspect, fps, duration, marks, the media (ids, kinds, lengths, transcripts) and each track with its clips [id, start, end, what it shows]. Capped at about 6,000 characters; project.read has every field.

commands.name: track.set
commands.description: Show, hide, mute, lock or rename a track: hidden, muted and locked are true or false.

commands.name: media.import
commands.description: Import a media file from nVideo's NakliOS storage (for example "media/clip.mp4"); in quick mode it also goes on the main track. Returns the media id.

commands.name: project.check
commands.description: Find problems a person would see: text off the frame or outside title-safe, text too short to read, gaps on the main track, clips past their file, missing files, captions under vertical apps' buttons, long silent projects, and text with too little contrast against the picture behind it (WCAG: 3:1 for large text, 4.5:1 for small; it suggests a colour). Returns [{level, code, message, fix, clipId?, at?}].

commands.name: captions.words
commands.description: Replace the Captions track with short captions of up to maxWords words from a transcribed clip, in the karaoke look that lights each word as it is spoken (word times are estimates).

commands.name: graphic.add
commands.description: Add a graphic on a text track: shape rect, line, bar (progress), counter (from, to, prefix, suffix, decimals) or chart (values, labels). w and h are fractions of the canvas; x and y place its centre (0-1).

graphic.description: Shape settings: color, w, h, radius, from, to, prefix, suffix, decimals, values, labels, value (bar fill 0-1)

commands.name: camera.add
commands.description: Add a camera move. A camera is a clip on a video track that pans, zooms, turns and shakes the picture of every track below it as one frame, while it lasts; text and graphic tracks above it do not move. With no trackId it goes on a camera track just above the video tracks. preset: pushIn (slow zoom in), pullOut (zoom out), panLeft, panRight, kenBurns (slow zoom with a drift), shake (handheld shake), whipPan (a fast pan that streaks off and back in, 0.5 s by default: centre it on a cut and turn on motion blur), none (a still camera to key by hand). intensity scales the move (0.1-3, default 1). Its x, y (pan, fractions of the frame), scale (zoom about the centre) and rotation (degrees) key with clip.keyframe; clip.set {camera: {preset, intensity}} rewrites the move, and {camera: {shake: 0-0.2, freq: 0.1-30 Hz, seed}} sets the shake.

trackId.description: Video track (optional; not the main track)

commands.name: template.list
commands.description: List the templates and their variables.

commands.name: template.apply
commands.description: Add a template at a time with values for its variables: hook-opener, countdown-321, list-three, versus-labels, question-card, series-badge, follow-card, news-strip, chapter-title, bullet-list, steps, compare, bar-chart, definition, testimonial, location-tag, title-card, lower-third, quote-card, stat-card, end-card. It goes on a new text track.

commands.name: clip.duplicate
commands.description: Copy a clip and paste the copy at a time (seconds), on its own track or another of the same kind. On the main track the copy is inserted and the track closes up.

at.description: Where the copy starts, in seconds

trackId.description: Track for the copy (default: the clip's own track)

commands.name: range.mark
commands.description: Set the in and out marks (seconds) that a range export renders; pass null for either to clear it.

in.description: In mark, seconds, or null to clear

out.description: Out mark, seconds, or null to clear

commands.name: export.video
commands.description: Export the timeline to a file in the person's storage. preset: mp4-1080, mp4-720, mp4-4k, webm-1080, webm-alpha (transparent where no clip covers the frame, for overlays), gif (480 px, 15 fps, no sound), png-zip (a PNG for every frame in a zip, transparent background, at most 900 frames), m4a / wav for the sound alone, or lossless to copy one untouched clip without re-encoding.

loudness.description: Normalise the sound to this many LUFS (for example -14), true peak under -1 dBTP

commands.name: file.save
commands.description: Save the project where it lives (NakliOS storage when hosted). A new project is saved under its name in NakliOS storage, or in this browser when not hosted. Media stays where it is; the project file holds the edit.

commands.name: file.save_as
commands.description: Save under a new name; the copy becomes the project you are editing. kind is naklios (hosted) or browser (standalone), default where it is now. A name already taken fails unless replace is true. Saving to this computer needs a person (File > Save as).

commands.name: file.open
commands.description: Show the Open page: Recent, then the projects in storage, then Browse this computer.

commands.name: file.new
commands.description: Show the New page (blank project).

commands.name: file.info
commands.description: The current project's name, where it is saved, and whether it has unsaved changes.

commands.name: file.export
commands.description: Export a copy in another format; the project stays where it is. Hosted, the copy goes to NakliOS storage under exports/; otherwise it downloads.

format.description: video opens the export dialog (a person picks the preset; agents use export.video); srt and vtt are the captions; png is the frame at the playhead

commands.name: assistant.ask
commands.description: Ask nVideo's assistant to do a job in the open project (for example build, rewrite or format it). It opens the Ask pane, starts at once and returns a job id; follow it with assistant.status.

request.description: What to do, in plain words

commands.name: assistant.status
commands.description: The state of nVideo's assistant job (the latest when job is omitted): running, done, failed, stopped or limit, with its last steps and summary.

commands.name: assistant.stop
commands.description: Stop nVideo's running assistant job.

errorCodes.meaning: The clip, media, track, LUT or nest named does not exist.
The media file is not loaded; relink it.
The timeline or range is empty, or nothing makes sound.
The operation does not apply to this kind of clip or track.
Something must be placed or chosen first.
This browser cannot do it (codec, API or model missing).
The file is not a valid nVideo project.
A colour is not in a form nVideo accepts (#rrggbb or rgb()).
A number is outside its allowed range, or a time falls outside the clip or media.
A value is not one of the allowed choices.
